== Welcome,  Healbatto! ==
[[File:WOTcalendarlogo.png|right|375px]]
Hello, and [[Wikipedia:Welcome, newcomers|welcome]] to '''A Wheel of Time Wiki'''!. Thanks for your edit to the [[:Aes Sedai]] page. I hope you like the place and decide to stay. Here are a few good links for newcomers:

* '''Local:'''
**[[Help:Style guide|Detailed style guide (in progress)]]
**[[project:Be bold|Be bold! We need your help!]]
**[[Help:Edit_summary|Leave an edit summary when you make changes]]
**[[Help:Contents|All help pages]]
*'''Wikipedia:'''
**[[m:Help:Editing|How to edit a page]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Tutorial|Tutorial]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Five pillars|The five pillars of Wikipedia]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:How to write a great article|How to write a great article]]

I hope you enjoy editing here and helping us get this project started. By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Mainphramephreak|Mainphramephreak]] ([[User_talk:Mainphramephreak|Talk]]) 21:27, November 27, 2010
|}

== Advice ==

Hello. Thanks for joining up with the site. As for advice, I would take a look at the links in the welcome message above. That will help in getting familiar with the site in specific as well as wiki editing in general, if you don't know any of it already. Something else; if you ask a question on a talk page, you don't need to also create a blog post about it as well. Also, on talk pages, please make sure you add your signature with either the button in the tool bar or four "~"'s. Again, welcome to the site! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:07, November 30, 2010 (UTC)
